d.ko: 매일 밤 바뀌는 빅토리아풍 저택을 배경으로 펼쳐지는 2.5D 공포 액션 RPG입니다.
d.en: Withering Rooms is a challenging 2.5D horror RPG set in a procedurally generated Victorian mansion that changes each night. Explore Mostyn House to collect the perfect items for your build and face a huge cast of overgrown undead, invisible ghosts, devious witches, and more.
d.zh: 穿越维多利亚式庄园，每个夜晚都蕴含着不测的恐怖，探索这款2.5D恐怖动作角色扮演游戏。
